scope: Operational source-checked pilot, not an independently human-rated benchmark
limits: Codex reviewed source support, motivation and naturalness; independent human listening ratings remain optional and uncollected.
The original twenty emphasize rules/constraints. Four separate text probes add explicit responsibility, a commitment and a revised proposal; they are not added to the 105-question audio-bank count.
Neither citation count nor recent-reader failure proves multi-hop reasoning.

scoring.full: All required answer facts are present and no unsupported material changes the answer.
scoring.partial: Some required facts are missing, an attribution/qualification is incomplete, or extra ungrounded detail materially weakens an otherwise useful answer.
scoring.incorrect: The main fact, owner, decision state, number or answerability is wrong.
scoring.unsupported: Citation correctness is checked separately from answer correctness; a real segment ID does not make a claim supported.
